_note: Everything that happens every single week, whichever rotation week it is. Recipe ids are keys in recipes.json.

rhythm.what: Order online. Open the basket, add to the trolley, book the slot.
Pizza dough out of the freezer into the fridge.
Delivery. Pizza night - every week, no exceptions.
Sandwiches for lunch. Prep session in the evening, 2-3 hours. That night's dinner is the traybake, cooked during the session.
Tuna pasta salad for lunch, made Saturday. Roast for dinner.
Leftovers from the roast, build-your-own. Together night.
Shift dinners - reheats, slow cooker, oven timers. Nothing over 15 minutes' active effort.
Thursday's freezer bag out of the freezer into the fridge.

adults.notes: 1 dough ball, passata, that week's topping, less mozzarella than the boys'. Topping under the cheese.

friday_pizza.salad: Every Friday has a salad alongside - see the week's page.

saturday_lunch.notes: Cold lunch - bread, ham, cheddar, salad, pickled onions. Double filling on the adults'.

sunday_lunch.notes: Made Saturday. Yoghurt and seeds added on Sunday.

smoothie_bags.notes: Fill all bags one ingredient at a time. Back in the freezer standing in a tub.

boiled_eggs.usage: 2 in the tuna pasta salad, 4 in Friday's salad, 1 in Thursday's lunch box, 1 spare

pickled_onions.frequency: Every Saturday, or skip if the jar from last week is still good - they keep 4-6 weeks.

flapjacks.frequency: Every Saturday, first thing in the oven at 180C
flapjacks.notes: The variant changes per week - see the week's page.

lunch_boxes.finishers: Different every day - that is where the variety comes from. See the week's page.
lunch_boxes.build_notes: Bottom-to-top so the leaves stay out of the dressing. Finisher last. Crunchy ones and boiled eggs go on the day, not into the box on Saturday.

dressings.notes: Make the three oil-based dressings in jars on day 1 of the cycle. They keep 3-4 weeks. Mint yoghurt is weekly and only needed in week 2.

cycle_1.description: Double the freezer bags - 2 per week instead of 1. Batch pots bank 1 bag each on top. Goal is ~9 dinners banked by the end of the month.

cycle_2_onwards.description: Single freezer bags only. Batch pots still bank 1 bag each. The freezer grows slowly.

freezer_bank.freezer_week: When the tub holds 8+ bags, skip a cook session. Shop only fresh things. Eat 5 bags that week, oldest first.

cook_order.detail: First in the oven, 180C. They cool while everything else cooks.
Oven up to 200C once the flapjacks are out. The lunch box veg goes in.
Marinated or oiled, on a second tray alongside the veg.
Tonight's dinner. In alongside or straight after the veg.
On the hob, simmering through all of the oven work.
While the pot simmers. 8 minutes, then cold water.
Freezer bags assembled, smoothie bags filled, dressings made, pickles done, tuna pasta salad made.
Last, once the veg and protein have cooled enough.
Tubs to the fridge, bags to the freezer, everything labelled with the month.

not_made_saturday: All pasta, rice, orzo and couscous - cooked fresh on the day, every time.
Fried eggs and anything crunchy for the lunch boxes.
Monday's peppers and anything else that wants to be hot.
The tarka, if it is a dal week.

today_button.notes: Which rotation week and which day today is, worked out from the anchor Friday.
